items.distractor_fact: მეზობელ სოფელში იმავე დილით ტემპერატურა იყო {D}°C.
items.gloss_en: In the neighboring village, the temperature that same morning was {D}°C.
items.entity_note: a different village's own thermometer, not the one village whose dawn and noon readings are compared

items.distractor_fact: მეორე კომპანიის აქცია იმავე დღეს დაიხურა {D}$-ად.
items.gloss_en: A second company's stock closed that same day at {D}$.
items.entity_note: a different company's stock, not the one whose opening and closing prices are given

items.distractor_fact: მეზობელ მდინარეზე იმავე დილით დონე იყო {D} მეტრი.
items.gloss_en: On the neighboring river, the level that same morning was {D} meters.
items.entity_note: a different river's own gauge, not the river whose morning and evening levels are given

items.gloss_en: The neighboring peak's altitude comes to {D} meters.
items.entity_note: a different, fixed peak, not the start or end altitude of this hike

items.distractor_fact: სხვა ანგარიშზე იმავე თვეს შევიდა {D} ლარი.
items.gloss_en: Into a different account, that same month, {D} lari was deposited.
items.entity_note: a different account's own deposit, not the account whose deposit and withdrawal are given

items.distractor_fact: სხვა გუნდმა ამ სეზონში გაიტანა {D} გოლი.
items.gloss_en: A different team scored {D} goals this season.
items.entity_note: a different team's own season tally, not the one team whose scored and conceded goals are given

items.distractor_fact: სხვა ინვესტორმა ამ წელს მოიგო {D} ლარი.
items.gloss_en: A different investor gained {D} lari this year.
items.entity_note: a different investor's own gain, not the investor whose gains and losses are given

items.distractor_fact: მეორე ქარხანამ ამავე თვეს დაამზადა {D} ერთეული პროდუქცია.
items.gloss_en: A second factory produced {D} units that same month.
items.entity_note: a different factory's own (unstated) actual output, not the factory whose actual and planned output are compared

items.distractor_fact: მეზობელმა მაღაზიამ ამავე თვეს გაყიდა {D} ლარის ღირებულების საქონელი.
items.gloss_en: A neighboring shop sold {D} lari worth of goods that same month.
items.entity_note: a different shop's own (unstated) sales, not the shop whose actual sales and target are compared

items.distractor_fact: სხვა მოთამაშემ სხვა ტურზე დააფიქსირა {D} დარტყმა.
items.gloss_en: A different player, in a different tournament round, recorded {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: a different golfer on a different course whose par is not stated, not the player being compared to this course's par

items.distractor_fact: სხვა ხაზის მატარებელი იმ დილით ჩამოვიდა {D} წუთზე.
items.gloss_en: A train on a different line arrived that same morning at minute {D}.
items.entity_note: a train on a different line with its own unstated timetable, not the train being compared to its schedule

items.distractor_fact: მესამე გუნდმა იმავე კვირას გაიტანა {D} გოლი.
items.gloss_en: A third team scored {D} goals that same week.
items.entity_note: a third team, distinct from team A and team B, whose own goal count is not part of the A-vs-B comparison
